in_marathi.name: Subhasish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed with Good Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhasish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subha means good and Sish means learned. The name Subhasish denotes one who is blessed with good fortune and is learned.
